title: A guest wants to start with their website
message: Get started with my website dutrou.com

complete_sign_in.note: This conversation is now tied to this account. Right after this reply you answer again, automatically, with its access: here just say in a few words that they are in. Never ask them to send anything to continue.

facts: This person has no distribute.you account: the assistant sees no account and can change nothing.
What distribute.you offers is on its public site (https://distribute.you/llms.txt, /catalog, /terms): read it with read_our_website, whatever it says is true.

An account is created right in this conversation: the person's email, the 6-digit code sent to it (on the website also a phone number for urgent matters), then the setup, the first payment through a link and the launch, all here.
The person wants to start: the next step is their account, created here.
expect: Starts right here: asks for their email to create the account in this conversation (or calls start_sign_in when it has them). Never sends them to a sign-up page or the dashboard to start, never asks for the website again.
